claims.text: Enable and disable stations
claims.note: Tile title. Every row, at area, hole and station level, carries a switch bound to its enabled state (sa-table-card.component.html:67-69), under the header STRINGS.ENABLE "Enable" (sa-dash-table.component.html:26).

claims.text: Cascading enable state across areas, holes and stations.
claims.note: Tile summary. The cascade exists on production, but only as a Shift-click on an area or hole switch (sa-table-card.component.ts:336). It sets the row and every hole and station record beneath it in one transaction (SpatialAdjustService.cs:1316-1407). A plain click changes only the row itself; see enable-disable-stations/2/1.

claims.text: Take a station, hole or area out of adjustment — and understand what cascading does before you confirm it.
claims.note: All three levels can be switched off, and a station under a disabled area or hole is left off the push list (sa-dashboard.component.ts:615-641). The confirmation appears only for a Shift-click cascade, and not at all once the user has suppressed it (sa-table-card.component.ts:336-347).

claims.text: Table, Enable column
claims.note: Retyped from behaviour to label. STRINGS.ENABLE "Enable" is the last column header at every table level (sa-dash-table.component.html:26), and the switch sits in that column on every row (sa-table-card.component.html:67-69).

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust, with the table showing the stations of one hole.
claims.note: Start state. The route is /spatialadjust (app-routing.module.ts:19-23). Station rows show once the table has been taken down from an area to a hole by selecting a row name (sa-dash-table.component.ts:108-118; sa-table-card.component.ts:290-304); the table drills course, areas, holes, stations.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: Start state. Both dashboard dialogs, Push Changes and Settings, are drawn only while their flag is set, and both flags start false (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:67-68; sa-main-toolbar.component.html:94-112). The cascade box is drawn only after a Shift-click (sa-table-card.component.html:101-107).

claims.text: A Spatial Adjust account on a site with TurfRad scan data.
claims.note: Start state. Same prerequisite as dashboard-overview/before/1: a Spatial Adjust user on a site with TurfRad scan data.

claims.text: A disabled station is excluded from adjustment entirely; it is not sent a zero, it is simply not sent.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour; the source settles it. The pending list, which is what Push Changes sends, keeps only stations whose area and hole are enabled and that have at least one enabled sprinkler record (sa-dashboard.component.ts:615-641). No other step filters on the enabled flag, and disabling only writes that flag (SpatialAdjustService.cs:1256-1309), so nothing is sent to Lynx and Lynx keeps whatever Pct Adjust it was last given; the guide could say so. The station is excluded from the push, not from the calculation: the table still shows its Current, Suggested and an editable % Adj. (sa-table-card.component.html:39-63), without the push icon (:51). 373-1135 rev 02 §Push Changes Functionality: a station whose parents are not enabled is not included in the list. For the multi-sprinkler caveat see enable-disable-stations/1/2.

claims.text: Toggle a single station
claims.note: Step title. On a station row the switch always acts alone, Shift or not (sa-table-card.component.ts:336).

claims.text: In the [[Enable]] column, select the switch on a station’s row.
claims.note: Every row carries a switch in the last column, whose header is STRINGS.ENABLE "Enable" (sa-dash-table.component.html:26; sa-table-card.component.html:67-69; en-us.json:695). On a station row the switch changes that station alone (sa-table-card.component.ts:336-338).

claims.text: The switch turns gray, and the station is switched off.
claims.note: Off is the grey track of the nova-light switch (enable-disable-stations/1/4), and the station is then disabled (sa-table-card.component.ts:334-338, :488-505). Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: If the rows are areas or holes, you are not at station level.
claims.note: Area and hole rows also carry the switch, so a reader can be on them. Selecting the name of an area or hole row takes the table down a level (sa-table-card.component.html:22; sa-table-card.component.ts:290-304; sa-dash-table.component.ts:108-118); station rows are the last level.

claims.text: Select a row name to go down until stations show.
claims.note: Area and hole rows also carry the switch, so a reader can be on them. Selecting the name of an area or hole row takes the table down a level (sa-table-card.component.html:22; sa-table-card.component.ts:290-304; sa-dash-table.component.ts:108-118); station rows are the last level.

claims.text: A station that is switched off is left out of the push, however dry it reads.
claims.note: A disabled station is left out of the pending push list, however dry it reads (sa-dashboard.component.ts:615-641; sa-table-card.component.html:51). The multi-sprinkler caveat in enable-disable-stations/1/2 applies to the same sentence.

claims.text: A disabled station: the switch on its row is gray.
claims.note: Figure caption. The switch is PrimeNG's p-inputSwitch under the nova-light theme (angular.json:80), whose off state is a grey track and on state blue. No Spatial Adjust style overrides it; the only inputswitch override in the site styles is scoped to a dashboard widget container. Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: Shift-click a parent to cascade
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (enable-disable-stations/2/1); docs/text-corrections.md §26 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Hold Shift and select the switch in the [[Enable]] column on a hole row.
claims.note: Hole and area rows carry the switch under the Enable column header (sa-dash-table.component.html:26; sa-table-card.component.html:67-69). With Shift held on an area or hole switch the change cascades (sa-table-card.component.ts:336-347). The corrected wording of enable-disable-stations/2/1 to /2/3 is kept.

claims.text: A box opens that names the hole and every station beneath it.
claims.note: A Shift-click opens the Cascade box, which for a hole reads "This will disable the selected hole and every station beneath it." (sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.html:14-19; sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.ts:35-42; en-us.json:382-385).

claims.text: If no box opens and the stations beneath did not change, Shift was not held.
claims.note: Without Shift, or on a station row, the switch calls the single-row update and does not cascade (sa-table-card.component.ts:336-338).

claims.text: Without Shift, the switch changes only its own row.
claims.note: Without Shift, or on a station row, the switch calls the single-row update and does not cascade (sa-table-card.component.ts:336-338).

claims.text: Without Shift, a hole that is off leaves the stations beneath it out of the push, but their own switches stay as they were.
claims.note: Carried over from the corrected enable-disable-stations/2/3: a plain click on a hole or area switch takes everything beneath it out of the push, but leaves their own switches as they were (sa-dashboard.component.ts:615-619; sa-table-card.component.ts:336-338).

claims.text: Hole rows carry their own Enable switch.
claims.note: Figure caption. Hole rows are built with the hole's own enabled flag (sa-dash-table.component.ts:318-333) and render the same switch (sa-table-card.component.html:67-69).

claims.text: Confirm the cascade
claims.note: Step title. The confirmation appears only for a Shift-click on an area or hole switch, and only while the user has not suppressed it (sa-table-card.component.ts:339-347; sa-table-card.component.html:101-107).

claims.text: Select [[Continue]] to switch off the hole and every station beneath it.
claims.note: SPATIAL_ADJUST.CONTINUE "Continue" runs the cascade, which switches the row and every hole and station beneath it in one transaction (sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.ts:54-61; sa-table-card.component.ts:356-360; SpatialAdjustService.cs:1316-1407; en-us.json:387).

claims.text: The box closes, and the footer says the cascade is complete.
claims.note: After Continue the box closes and the footer reports "Cascade Disable for '<row>' complete" (sa-table-card.component.ts:356-360, :532-534; en-us.json:384).

claims.text: If this is not the change you want, select [[Cancel]].
claims.note: STRINGS.CANCEL "Cancel" flips the switch back without a server call, so nothing is saved (sa-table-card.component.ts:350-354; sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.html:33-36; en-us.json:636).

claims.text: The switch goes back to how it was, and nothing is saved.
claims.note: STRINGS.CANCEL "Cancel" flips the switch back without a server call, so nothing is saved (sa-table-card.component.ts:350-354; sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.html:33-36; en-us.json:636).

claims.text: The cascade confirmation names exactly what will change.
claims.note: Figure caption. The dialog names the level and "every hole and station" or "every station" beneath it (en-us.json:382, :385); it does not list or count them.

claims.text: Silence the prompt once you trust it
claims.note: Step title. The dialog carries the opt-out checkbox (sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.html:22-25).

claims.text: Tick [[Don’t ask to confirm cascading enable/disable changes again]] before you select [[Continue]].
claims.note: DONT_ASK_FOR_CASCADE_CONFIMRATION "Don’t ask to confirm cascading enable/disable changes again" is a checkbox in the box (sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.html:22-25; en-us.json:392). It is saved when Continue is selected (sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.ts:52-61).

claims.text: The box is ticked, and after [[Continue]] a Shift-click no longer asks you first.
claims.note: Once saved, a Shift-click cascades without the box (sa-table-card.component.ts:339-343).

claims.text: If you select [[Cancel]] with the box ticked, nothing is saved, and the prompt keeps coming.
claims.note: The flag is written only on Continue; ticking the box and selecting Cancel saves nothing (sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.ts:52-61), so the box keeps coming.

claims.text: The choice is saved for you only, and no screen on the dashboard turns the prompt back on.
claims.note: The flag saHideCascadeConfirmation is in the signed-in user's preferences (dash-user-preferences.model.ts:87) and is only ever set to true: no screen turns it back on (sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.ts:56), and the preferences dialog does not show it (see the note on enable-disable-stations/4/2).

claims.text: The same dialog for an area-level enable.
claims.note: Figure caption. For an area the body is SPATIAL_ADJUST.CASCADE_AREA, "Enable this area and all child holes and stations?" when enabling (sa-confirm-cascade-dlg.component.ts:36-39; en-us.json:382), under the title "Cascade Enable" (en-us.json:383).

claims.text: Careful. With the prompt suppressed, a Shift-click on an area switch changes every hole and station under it at once, with only a footer message to show for it.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (enable-disable-stations/4/5); docs/text-corrections.md §26 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Careful. With the prompt suppressed, an area-level toggle silently changes every hole and station under it.

claims.text: Open Layers on the map
claims.note: Step title. Layers is the map control at the bottom of the map (sa-map-overlay.component.html:34-41).

claims.text: Select [[Layers]] at the bottom of the map.
claims.note: STRINGS.LAYERS "Layers" is the button of the map overlay, shown upper-case (sa-map-overlay.component.html:34-41; en-us.json:782).

claims.text: A list opens with [[All Stations]] and [[Enabled Stations]].
claims.note: The Layers list holds two radios, CASE_SENSITIVE.ALL_STATIONS "All Stations" and CASE_SENSITIVE.ENABLED_STATIONS "Enabled Stations" (sa-map-overlay.component.html:41-61).

claims.text: If the list does not open, select [[Layers]] again.
claims.note: A click on the Layers button toggles the list (sa-map-overlay.component.html:35), so a second click opens it if the first closed it.

claims.text: Layers, at the bottom of the map.
claims.note: Figure caption. Layers is the control at the bottom of the map (sa-map-overlay.component.html:34-41).

claims.text: Check the result on the map
claims.note: Step title. The map redraws its markers whenever a row's enabled state changes (sa-dash-map.component.ts:199-210).

claims.text: Select [[Enabled Stations]] in the list.
claims.note: Enabled Stations is the second radio (sa-map-overlay.component.html:52-60). On production it is already the default, so for most users the step is a check (environment.toro-prod.ts:88).

claims.text: The map shows only the stations that are still switched on.
claims.note: The map hides every station that fails the enabled test (sa-dash-map.component.ts:312, :351-374): the area and hole are enabled and at least one sprinkler record of the station is enabled.

claims.text: If a station you switched off is still on the map, another sprinkler of that station may still be on.
claims.note: A station is drawn while any one of its sprinkler records is enabled (sa-dash-map.component.ts:351-374; sa-dashboard.component.ts:626-641). The station switch updates only the first record of a multi-sprinkler station (enable-disable-stations/1/2), so another record can keep it on the map.

claims.text: A station that has gone from the map will not be pushed.
claims.note: The map's enabled test is the same rule the push list applies (sa-dash-map.component.ts:351-374; sa-dashboard.component.ts:615-641), so a station that has gone from the map is not pushed (enable-disable-stations/5/3).

claims.text: Layers filtered to enabled stations only.
claims.note: Figure caption. The Enabled Stations radio button (sa-map-overlay.component.html:52-60) hides every station that fails the enabled test (sa-dash-map.component.ts:312).

claims.text: The stations you meant to disable show a gray switch, or sit under a hole or area whose switch is gray.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (enable-disable-stations/verify/1); docs/text-corrections.md §26 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines. Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.
claims.previousText: The stations you meant to disable show a grey switch.

claims.text: The Push Changes count dropped by the pending edits you just excluded.
claims.note: Retyped from label to behaviour. Disabling rebuilds the pending list (sa-dashboard.component.ts:176-188, :607-678), and the number on the Push Changes button counts pending stations not already pushed today (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:146-160; sa-main-toolbar.component.html:34-42). It drops by the excluded stations that were pending, edited or not, less any already pushed today. "Pending edits" means stations whose % Adj. differs from Lynx's Current, as in bulk-adjustments/verify/3.
